rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose noun for a person sent or authorized to speak or act for others, including a delegate.

example.english: We sent a representative to talk to the school.
example.traditional: 我哋派咗個代表去同校方傾。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 paai3 zo2 go3 doi6 biu2 heoi3 tung4 haau6 fong1 king1

rows.note: Use this for something that stands for or symbolizes another idea or quality.

example.english: The white dove is representative of peace.
example.jyutping: baak6 gap3 hai6 wo4 ping4 ge3 zoeng6 zing1

rows.note: Use this specifically for a member of a legislative or elected governing body rather than a general delegate.

example.english: That representative, a councillor, proposed a plan at the district council.
example.traditional: 嗰位議員喺區議會提出咗個方案。
example.jyutping: go2 wai2 ji5 jyun4 hai2 keoi1 ji5 wui6 tai4 ceot1 zo2 go3 fong1 on3

rows.note: Use this for a person or thing regarded as a typical example of its class.

example.english: He is representative of the typical Hong Kong office worker.
example.traditional: 佢係典型嘅香港打工仔。
example.jyutping: keoi5 hai6 din2 jing4 ge3 hoeng1 gong2 daa2 gung1 zai2
